node.text: Hii this is the clarity 2 days back naaku oka incident jarigindhi Morning shift 5.30 bus lo untey window lo nunchi ... oka abbayi “na sister ki periods, help kavali” ani adigadu First lo nijam ani anipinchi help cheyadaniki vellanu Kaani place matram malli malli change chesthunnadu Road lo undhi annadu, tarvatha hostel lo undhi annadu Hostel lopalaki teesukoni velladaniki try chesadu Kaani nenu akkade aapi “nuvvu endhuku velthunav” ani question chesanu Akkadanunchi naaku strong doubt vachindhi Friends ni pilustha ani cheppagane akkadanunchi vellipoyadu Tarvatha vere ammayini kuda ade vidhamga approach chesadu Girls please careful ga undandi Unknown persons tho ekkadiki vellakandi Emotional stories ni blind ga nammakandi Public place lo ne help cheyyandi Doubt vaste immediate ga no cheppandi Police ki inform cheyadam hesitate avvakandi
